correctedFinding.observed: A finance browser run saw one ERR_FAILED for the translation mapping endpoint; the strict transport check failed although the business form rendered.
correctedFinding.transportRootCause: The original transport failure was transient and its external cause was not established; an immediate unchanged-browser recheck passed.
correctedFinding.confirmedCodeDefect: fetchMessages converted transport failures into successful empty dictionaries, allowing the provider to mark failed namespaces as loaded.
correctedFinding.fix: Bounded retries for shared-client network/timeout errors only (three attempts, 250/750 ms backoff). Exhausted failures and invalid responses reject; authorization and abort errors do not retry. The existing provider therefore retains failed namespaces as unloaded.

verified.failureInjection: Chrome Fetch.failRequest; only this private browser, no service/network configuration changes

limitations: Formula publication remains guarded. Durable target backfill/undo, trusted APP projection, final designer/runtime integration and B1–B5 business fixtures remain incomplete. The 176-entry final calculation matrix has no final passed entries; these office regressions do not replace it.
The new nonterminal publication protocol has database-backed tests. Production currently exercises legacy terminal responses and idempotent replay, since the batch producer is not enabled.
The previously documented 143 tenant implementation formatting findings in unrelated files remain a final quality-gate task; this report does not claim the entire repository checkstyle gate passes.
